name: mi-empresa-app
description: Mi Empresa - Sistema de gestión empresarial

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d postgres
scripts.setup: npm run db:up && sleep 3 && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.lint: cd backend && npm run lint && cd ../frontend && npm run lint
